name: The Sun-Coil Spire
core_rationale: Northern thermal-brass tower of Mainspring Caldera at [1, 0] where solar mirrors and barometer vanes harvest high-altitude wind to charge the upper sky-docks.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Glider captains say the upper Sun-Coil Spire platform aligns with a floating brass dock from Continent 03 once every solstice.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A spiraling tower of polished copper heliostats and spinning barometer cups rising out of the northern caldera rim.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What sky-ship blueprint is locked inside the Master Clockmakers' barometer observatory?

causal_continuity.evidence: Forms the northern high-altitude thermal spire of Mainspring Caldera on Continent 02.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Spiraling tower of polished copper heliostats and spinning barometer cups above the caldera clouds.
